blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Optical character recognition (OCR) for Tibetan is evaluated predominantly by character error rate (CER). Tibetan marks syllable boundaries but does not mark word boundaries, so a word error rate requires a segmenter. This study evaluates nine recognizer configurations on typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles, alone and in combination, and reports syllable- and word-level error rates, to our knowledge the first for Tibetan OCR. The configurations span CTC models, TrOCR encoder-decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model, and each is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall $τ\geq 0.833$), with one pair ordered oppositely. On the effect of joint training, CER and SER record significant changes of opposite sign in 7 of 64 comparisons. SER needs no segmenter and ranks systems as SWER does under two of the three segmenters ($τ\geq 0.889$). The output of each configuration is also tagged for part of speech, annotated for named entities and machine translated, and each result is compared with that obtained on the reference text. As rough guidance, translation chrF of 60 is reached at SER of 0.047 or below and part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 at 0.078 or below, while no error rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that do not.
blocks.zh: 藏语的光学字符识别(OCR)主要通过字符出错率(CER)来评价. 藏语标记分音节边界但不标出单词边界,因此一个单词出错率需要分节. 本研究评价了9个识别器配置,涉及排字,木块和两个手写脚本样式,单独和组合,并报告音节和字位误差率,据我们所知,这是西藏OCR的第一个. 这些配置跨越了CTC模型,TrOCR编码器与后训练分解,以及一个视觉语言模型,每个模型在CER,音节出错率(SER)和三个分词出错率(SWER)下得分. CER主要按照较高水平的费率(Kendall $τ\geq 0.833美元)对系统进行排序,一对则以相反方式订购. 关于联合培训的效果,CER和SER在64个比较中的7个记录了相反标志的重大变化. SER不需要分机,也不需要像SWER那样在三个分机中的两个分机(0.889美元)下排序系统。 每个配置的输出也会被标记为部分语音,被注释为被命名的实体和被翻译的机器,每个结果都会被比较到参考文本中获得的结果. 作为粗略的取向,翻译为60的chrF在0.047或以下的SER和0.078或以下的话段保存为0.8,而没有出错率将达到实体保存为0.6的系统与不达到的系统区分开来.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Optical character recognition (OCR) and handwritten text recognition are applied to Tibetan prints and manuscripts, including to make large collections of Buddhist texts searchable ( Luo and Chuang, 2024 ; Griffiths, 2024 ; Erhard, 2025 ) . Recognition of continuous Tibetan text is typically evaluated by character error rate (CER) ( Griffiths, 2024 ; Erhard, 2025 ; Sabbagh, 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . The orthography of Tibetan makes word error rates, typical in other languages ( Neudecker et al., 2021 ; Vesalainen et al., 2026 ) , difficult to compute.
blocks.zh: 光学字符识别(OCR)和手写文字识别适用于藏文印刷品和手稿,包括使大量藏传佛教文字可以搜索(Luo and Chuang, 2024; Griffiths, 2024; Erhard, 2025). 对连续藏文文字的识别一般通过字符错误率(CER)来评价(Griffiths,2024;Erhard,2025;Sabbagh,2025;徐等人,2026). 藏语的正字法使得其他语言中典型的词错误率(Neudecker等人,2021年;Vesalainen等人,2026年)难以计算.

blocks.en: In scripts that delimit a unit larger than the character, CER and an error rate over that unit can rank systems differently ( Agbeti-Messan et al., 2026 ; Le et al., 2025 ) . OCR error also degrades the downstream tasks that use the recognized text ( van Strien et al., 2020 ) . Named-entity recognition falls sharply once word-level error reaches 8–20% ( Hamdi et al., 2019 ) , and corrupting named-entity spans reduces keyword search performance while CER and word error rate remain low ( Jaud et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在划定一个大于字符的单位的脚本中,CER和该单位的错误率可以对系统进行不同的排序(Agbeti-Messan等人,2026年;Le等人,2025年)。 OCR错误还降解了使用公认文本的下游任务(van Strien等人,2020年). 一旦字位错误达到8–20%(Hamdi等人,2019年),且腐败的名实体会减少关键词搜索性能,而CER和字位错误率仍然很低(Jaud等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Tibetan explicitly marks syllable boundaries, chiefly with the tsheg ( \tibetanfont ་), but does not mark word boundaries. A word error rate therefore requires a segmenter. The syllable is an intermediate unit that requires none, and segmented word error rates have been applied to Tibetan speech recognition ( Moore et al., 2026 ) . To our knowledge, no error rate above the character has been reported for Tibetan OCR. It is therefore not known whether CER leads an evaluator to the same choices as a syllable- or word-level rate would, or which rate best predicts the quality of downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 藏语明确标注了音节边界,主要与tsheg(\tibetanfont QQ),但并不标注字形边界. 因此,单词错误率需要一个分段器。 音节是一个中间单元,不需要任何音节,片段字误差率已被应用于藏语语音识别(Moore等人,2026年). 据我们所知,西藏OCR没有报告过高于字符的错误率. 因此,目前还不清楚的是,CER是否使评估者作出与音节或词级比率相同的选择,或者哪个比率最能预测下游任务的质量。

blocks.en: Nine recognizer configurations are evaluated, spanning CTC models, TrOCR encoder–decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model. They are trained on four datasets, covering modern typeset text, woodblock print and two handwritten styles, and on three mixed-domain combinations of them to compare joint with single-domain training. This gives 60 configuration × \times condition cells. Each cell is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). On the four single-domain conditions, recognizer output is also tagged for part of speech, annotated for named entities and machine translated into English, and each result is scored against the result obtained on the reference transcription. These preservation scores measure the effect of recognition error on each task.
blocks.zh: 评估了9个识别器的配置,跨越了CTC模型,TrOCR编码器-解码器有和没有训练后量化,以及一个视觉语言模型。 他们接受四个数据集的培训,涵盖现代排字文字,木块印刷和两个手写样式,以及三个混合域组合,以比较联合域与单域训练. 这给出了60个配置×\times条件细胞. 每个单元格在CER,音节误差率(SER)和三个分段字误差率(SWER)下得分. 在四个单域条件上,识别器输出也被标记为部分语音,对命名的实体和机器进行注释,并翻译成英语,每个结果都会与参考语录中获得的结果进行打分. 这些保存分数衡量识别错误对每项任务的影响.

blocks.en: This study makes three contributions.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有三项贡献。

blocks.en: (1) A comparative evaluation of Tibetan OCR across architectures, quantization and script domains. Configurations are compared on page-grouped held-out splits with bootstrap intervals, under syllable- and word-level error rates that are, to our knowledge, the first publicly reported for Tibetan OCR. (2) A comparison of CER with syllable- and word-level rates. CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall τ ≥ 0.833 \tau\geq 0.833 ), but on the effect of joint training it records significant changes of opposite sign to SER in 7 of 64 comparisons. Word-level rankings agree across three segmenters at τ ≥ 0.833 \tau\geq 0.833 (§ 4.2 , § 5.1 , § 5.2 ). (3) Approximate error rates for downstream use. The SER needed for a rough preservation target ranges from 0.007 for entities to 0.078 for part-of-speech tags, so no single rate serves every task. LLM annotation also fails more often as OCR error rises (§ 4.4 , § 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: (1)西藏OCR跨架构,量化和脚本领域的比较评价. 将配置在按页分组的截断中进行对比,并有靴子间隔,在音节和词级误差率下进行对比,据我们所知,这是首次公开报道西藏OCR. (2) 将CER与音节和词位率进行比较。 CER主要按照较高水平的费率(Kendall \ 0.833 \ tau\geq 0.833 )对系统进行排名,但在64项比较中,有7项记录显示联合培训与SER的相反标志发生了重大变化。 三个部分的文字等级排名一致,为0.833\tau\geq 0.833(§4.2,§5.1,§5.2)。 (3)下游使用近似误差率. 粗略保存目标所需的SER从实体的0.007到部分语音标记的0.078不等,因此没有单一费率为每一项任务服务. 随着OCR错误的上升(§4.4,§5.3),LLM注释也更经常的失败.

blocks.en: 2. Background and Prior Work
blocks.zh: 2. 背景和前期工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Tibetan Script
blocks.zh: 2.1. 西藏文稿

blocks.en: 2.1.1. Structure

Tibetan is written in an abugida , a writing system whose base unit is a consonant carrying an inherent vowel, modified by diacritics. The fundamental unit of written Tibetan is the syllable, built from a root consonant that may carry superscript and subscript letters, a vowel diacritic, and prefix and suffix consonants ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . The root and its superscript and subscript form a single visual column, called a stack . Unicode encodes a stack as a sequence of codepoints rather than as a unit, so one visual column may consist of several codepoints.
blocks.zh: 藏文用 abugida 书写,一个写法系统,其基数单位是带有内在元音的调和,由二亚语修改. 书面藏语的基本单位是音节,由根对齐构建,可能带有上标字母和下标字母,元音二音,前缀和后缀对齐(黄等人,2025年). 根及其上标和下标组成一个单一的视觉柱,称为堆. Unicode将堆栈编码为代码点的序列而非单位,因此一个视觉列可能由几个代码点组成.

blocks.en: Syllables are separated by the tsheg ( \tibetanfont ་, U+0F0B) ( van Schaik, 2014 ) . Word boundaries are not marked. Nearly every word boundary is also a syllable boundary, but words may be polysyllabic ( Brown, 2024 ) , as also in Dzongkha ( Norbu et al., 2010 ) . Punctuation is sparse: the only mark occurring throughout running text is the shad ( \tibetanfont །, U+0F0D), which separates units larger than the syllable, roughly sentences ( van Schaik, 2014 ) , and so also ends the syllable before it. Syllable-level tokenization therefore splits on the tsheg, the shad and whitespace. Word-level tokenization requires a more complex segmentation step.
blocks.zh: 音节由tsheg(\tibetanfont ་,U+0F0B)(van Schaik,2014)分离. 字形边界没有标记. 几乎每个字的边界也是一个音节边界,但词可能是多音节(Brown, 2024),同样在Dzongkha(Norbu et al., 2010)中也有出现. 标点符号很少:整个运行的文本中唯一出现的标记是shad(\tibetanfont །,U+0F0D),它将比音节大的单位分开,大致的句子(van Schaik,2014),所以也结束了它之前的音节. 因此,Syll-level 代号在 tsheg, shad 和 White 空间上分裂. 词层符号化需要更复杂的分割步骤.

blocks.en: 2.1.2. Varieties and Media
blocks.zh: 2.1.2. 品种和媒体

blocks.en: Written Tibetan divides into two script families, distinguished by the presence or absence of a head , a short horizontal stroke along the top of many letters ( van Schaik, 2014 ) . Uchen (‘headed script’) is the formal block script and the basis for woodblock-carved prints and modern digital typesetting. Ume (‘headless script’) is the cursive family, whose letters lack a head and are written with more connected strokes, with substantially greater variability in letterform shape and positioning. Within Ume, Drutsa is a handwritten cursive ( Erhard, 2025 ) , and Betsug (‘book form’) is a calligraphic style ( van Schaik, 2014 ) . The two families differ enough that recognition does not necessarily transfer between them ( Griffiths, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 藏文分为两个剧本家庭, 区分为头部是否存在, Uchen( " 头条脚本 " )是正式的块形脚本,也是木块雕刻印刷和现代数字排版的基础。 Ume( " 无头脚本 " )是受咒骂的家族,其信件缺乏头部,书写时的中风联系较多,字母形状和定位的变异性要大得多。 在Ume内部,Drutsa为手写咒语(Erhard,2025年),Betsug("书本形式")为书法风格(van Schaik,2014年). 两个家庭差异很大,承认不一定相互转移(Griffiths,2024年)。

blocks.en: The physical medium varies independently of script variety. In woodblock prints each character is carved by hand, so letterforms vary more than in machine print, and manual printing can merge the strokes of neighbouring characters ( Hedayati et al., 2010 ) . Modern typeset text is uniform in letterform, while handwriting varies between writers ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 物理介质随脚本品种的不同而不同. 在木块印刷物中,每个字符都是用手雕刻的,因此字母形式比机器印刷物不同,手工印刷可以将相邻字符的中风合并(Hedayati等人,2010年). 现代的排字文字在字母形式上是统一的,而笔迹则因作者而异(周等人,2026年).

blocks.en: 2.2. Recognition Architectures
blocks.zh: 2.2. 承认结构

blocks.en: 2.2.1. Recognizers

Early Tibetan OCR systems decoded with hidden Markov models ( Hedayati et al., 2010 ; Rowinski and Keutzer, 2016 ) . More recent Tibetan recognition is neural, including convolutional and convolutional-recurrent networks ( Zhang et al., 2022 ; Wang and Wang, 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , an encoder–decoder for scene text ( Ke et al., 2025 ) , the PyLaia engine of Transkribus ( Griffiths, 2024 ; Erhard, 2025 ) and a vision-language model adapted to Tibetan ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . This study compares three kinds of neural recognizer. Connectionist temporal classification ( Graves et al., 2006 , CTC;) trains a sequence model to maximize the likelihood of the target over all valid frame-to-character alignments. Convolutional-recurrent networks ( Shi et al., 2017 ) and Easter2.0 ( Chaudhary and Bali, 2022 ) , which replaces the recurrence with convolutions, are both trained with CTC. Autoregressive encoder-decoders generate over the encoder output instead, as in TrOCR ( Li et al., 2023 ) . Vision-language models pair a vision encoder with a language decoder pretrained on a large multilingual corpus rather than on the recognition task; Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , whose decoder is built on Qwen3 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , is one such model.
blocks.zh: 早期藏语 OCR系统用隐藏的Markov模型解码(Hedayati等人,2010年;Rowinski和Keutzer,2016年). 较近的藏语识别是神经元,包括革命和革命-经常性网络(张等,2022年;王等,2024年;周等,2026年),场景文字的编码器–解码器(Ke等,2025年),Transkribus的PyLaia引擎(Griffiths,2024年;Erhard,2025年),以及一个适应藏语的视觉语言模型(徐等,2026年). 本研究比较了三种神经识别器. 联系时间分类法(Graves等人,2006年,CTC;)培训一个序列模型,以尽量扩大目标在所有有效框架与特征组合中的可能性。 革命-经常网络(Shi等人,2017年)和复活节2.0(Chaudhary和Bali,2022年),它们用革命取代了复发,两者都接受CTC的培训. 自动回转编码器-解码器在编码器输出上生成,如TrOCR(Li等人,2023年). 视觉语言模型将一个视觉编码器与语言解码器配对,在大型多语体上预先训练,而不是在识别任务上;Qune3-VL(Bai等人,2025年),其解码器建在Qune3上(Yang等人,2025年)就是这种模型之一.

blocks.en: 2.2.2. Quantization and Adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.2.2. 量化和适应

blocks.en: Quantization stores weights at lower numerical precision and may be applied to an already-trained model ( Dettmers et al., 2022a ) . Quantized low-rank adaptation ( Dettmers et al., 2023 , QLoRA;) quantizes a frozen base model and trains only small low-rank adapter matrices ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , which reduces the memory needed to fine-tune a large model.
blocks.zh: 量子化以较低的数值精度存储重量,并可能应用于已经训练好的模型(Dettmers等人,2022a.). 量化低等级适应(Dettmers等人,2023年,QLORA;) 将一个冷冻的基底模型进行定量,并仅列小的低等级适配器矩阵(Hu等人,2022年),这降低了微调大型模型所需的内存.

blocks.en: 2.3. Edit-Distance Error Rates
blocks.zh: 2.3. 编辑偏差误差率

blocks.en: In a full OCR pipeline, layout analysis and line segmentation precede recognition. This study takes line images as given and evaluates recognition alone. The recognized text of each line is scored against a reference transcription by the number of edits needed to turn one into the other, relative to the length of the reference.
blocks.zh: 在完整的OCR输油管中,排版分析和线路分割在识别之前. 本研究按给出的线形图像进行,仅评价识别. 每行的公认文字根据参考文献的抄录,根据参考文献的长度,按照将其中一行变为另一行所需的编辑次数打分.

blocks.en: Character, syllable and word error rates share the same formula, ER = S + D + I N , \mathrm{ER}=\frac{S+D+I}{N}, where S S , D D and I I are the substitutions, deletions and insertions in the hypothesis with respect to the reference , and N N is the count of units in the reference. Character error rate (CER) tokenizes over Unicode characters, syllable error rate (SER) over syllables delimited by the tsheg, the shad or whitespace, and segmented word error rate (SWER) over words, which for Tibetan requires a segmenter (§ 2.1.1 ). Three SWER variants were introduced for Tibetan automatic speech recognition (ASR) by Moore et al. (2026) . BoTok-SWER segments with the dictionary-based botok tokenizer, BERT-SWER with a Tibetan BERT token classifier ( tibetan-bert-base-upos ), and Gem-SWER with Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, prompted at temperature 0.0. Their agreement with human word-boundary annotation on speech transcripts, as reported there, is Cohen’s κ \kappa = 0.027, 0.372 and 0.656 respectively. For all of the error rates described here, lower error-rate values indicate better performance. Values above 1.0 occur when the edits outnumber the reference units, which requires insertions.
blocks.zh: 字符,音节和单词错误率共享相同的公式,ER=S + D + I N,\mathrm{ER}=\frac{S+D+I}{N},其中SS,DD和I为与引用相关的假设中的替换,删除和插入,NN为引用中的单位数. 字符错误率(CER)在Unicode字符上标注,音节错误率(SER)在tsheg,shad 或 whitespace所划分的音节上标注,在单词上标注分词错误率(SWER),对于藏语来说需要分词(§ 2.1.1). Moore等人(2026年)为藏语自动语音识别(ASR)引入了三种SWER变体. 博托克-SWER部分带有基于词典的博托克标注剂,BERT-SWER带有藏语BERT符号分类器(tibetan-bert-base-upos),Gem-SWER带有双子座2.5闪光液,在0.0温度下激发. 科恩的\kappa=0.027、0.372和0.656。 对于本文描述的所有错误率,较低的错误率值表明性能更好. 当编辑数超过参考单位时,值高于1.0,需要插入。

blocks.en: Because the three levels differ only in tokenization, they are not independent measurements, but errors falling on unit boundaries affect them differently: a single inserted or deleted delimiter counts as one character edit but corrupts both units it separates.
blocks.zh: 由于三个关卡仅在符号化上存在差异,它们并不是独立的测量,但是在单位边界上掉落的错误对它们有不同的影响:一个被插入或删除的分隔器作为一个字符编辑而计数,但腐蚀了它分开的两个单元.

blocks.en: 2.4. Prior Work
blocks.zh: 2.4. 先前的工作

blocks.en: 2.4.1. Evaluation Practice in Tibetan OCR
blocks.zh: 2.4.1. 西藏OCR的评价做法

blocks.en: Early Tibetan OCR systems scored output in units of Tibetan orthography rather than codepoints. Hedayati et al. (2010) evaluate a woodblock recognizer by Levenshtein distance over stack characters rather than codepoints, and Rowinski and Keutzer (2016) reports isolated-character accuracy and scores each page by a syllable validity ratio, the proportion of syllables that follow Tibetan spelling rules or appear in a list of accepted exceptions.
blocks.zh: 早期藏语 OCR系统以藏文正文单位而不是代号来评分输出. Hedayati等人(2010年)通过Levenshtein距离来评价一个木块识别器在堆积字符上而不是代码点上,Rowinski和Keutzer(2016年)报告了孤立的特征精确度,并以音节有效性比,按照藏语拼音规则或出现在被接受的例外列表中的音节比例对每页进行分数.

blocks.en: Recent OCR and handwritten text recognition (HTR) on continuous Tibetan text typically reports CER. Much of this work is built on Transkribus, which returns CER ( Griffiths, 2024 ; Erhard, 2025 ) , and Sabbagh (2025) reports mean and median CER on a held-out set. FTibSuite ( Xu et al., 2026 ) pairs CER with Exact Match, a whole-line binary, and notes that changes in the two are not perfectly aligned. Other tasks use other measures: work on isolated characters reports classification accuracy Wang and Wang, 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2022 ; see also the survey by Gongqu et al., 2024 . Work on scene text, evaluated on photographs of street views and outdoor environments, reports line accuracy, character accuracy and a normalized edit distance ( Ke et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近OCR和手写在连续藏文上的文字识别(HTR)一般报告CER. 大部分工作建立在Transkribus上,它返回CER(Griffiths,2024年;Erhard,2025年),以及Sabbagh(2025年)的报告在被搁置的一组中位CER上。 FTibSuite(Xu等人,2026年) CER配对 Exact Match,全线二进制,并指出两者的变化不完全对齐. 其他任务采用其他措施:关于孤立字符的作品报告分类精度为王和王,2024年;张等人,2022年;另见龚库等人的调查,2024年. 现场文本工作,对街景和户外环境的照片进行评估,报告行精度,人物精度和规范化编辑距离(Ke等人,2025年).

blocks.en: To our knowledge, no syllable- or word-level error rate has been reported for Tibetan OCR, though SER has been reported in Tibetan ASR ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Zhao et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,西藏OCR没有报告音节或词级误差率,尽管在西藏ASR中报告了SER(Wang等人,2020年;Zhao等人,2019年).

blocks.en: 2.4.2. Character and Word Error Rates in Other Scripts
blocks.zh: 2.4.2. 其他脚本中的字符和字词错误率

blocks.en: CER requires no tokenization beyond the codepoint and is computable for any script, including those that do not delimit words with whitespace. Thennal et al. (2025) advocate it as the preferred metric for multilingual ASR, on the grounds that for languages without word separators “the WER can only be applied after a subjective and potentially inaccurate word segmentation process”. Similar reasoning appears in OCR. Clérice (2022) judges WER “complicated to apply” to Old French and Medieval Latin, where spaces vary in size or are absent.
blocks.zh: CER在代码点之外不需要任何符号化,并且对任何脚本,包括那些没有用白空空间进行字词划分的脚本都可以计算. Enternal等人(2025年)主张它是多语种ASR的首选衡量标准,理由是对于没有字词分隔符的语言,“只有在主观和可能不准确的字词分割过程之后,才能应用WER”。 类似的推理出现在OCR中. Clérice(2022年)法官WER“复杂地适用于”古法语和中世纪拉丁语,其中的空间大小不同或不存在。

blocks.en: Where whitespace does delimit words, word error rate is reported alongside CER and comparison across the two levels is normal. The two levels often agree. Neudecker et al. (2021) plot CER and WER side by side, WER exceeding CER throughout, and the two systems compared by Vesalainen et al. (2026) are ranked the same way by both, though they differ in the kind of edits they make. Agreement is not general. Agbeti-Messan et al. (2026) , benchmarking historical newspaper OCR on Latin script, report a different best system under CER than under WER on each of their two subcorpora, though under 0.1 percentage points separates the CER of their leading models.
blocks.zh: 如果空白区域确实对单词进行划界,则报告单词误差率与CER并列,而两个级别之间的比较是正常的。 这两个层面经常同意。 Neudecker等人(2021年)将CER和WER并列,WER在全局中超过CER,而Vesalainen等人(2026年)比较的两个系统在两者中排名相同,尽管它们在编辑类型上有所不同. 协议不是一般性的。 Agbeti-Messan等人(2026年),将历史报纸OCR标注在拉丁文上,在CER下报告的最佳系统不同于在WER下报告其两个子公司,不过在0.1个百分点以下,它们的主要模型的CER分开.

blocks.en: An intermediate unit has been used in scripts where word boundaries are ambiguous: Naing et al. (2015) propose a syllable error rate for Myanmar speech recognition. Vietnamese words often span several space-separated syllables ( Le et al., 2025 ) , so a word error rate over space-delimited tokens is in effect a syllable error rate. In that survey’s line-level results the system with the lower CER (3.24% against 4.67%) has the higher syllable-level rate (14.11% against 13.33%).
blocks.zh: 在字段界限模糊的脚本中使用了一个中间单元: 纳音等. (2015)为缅甸语音识别提出音节错误率. 越南语单词经常跨越几个空间分隔的音节(Le et al., 2025),因此在空间限定符号上一个词错误率实际上是一个音节错误率. 在该调查的线级结果中,CER较低(3.24%对4.67%)的系统有较高的音节率(14.11%对13.33%)。

blocks.en: For Tibetan, the only comparison against a word-level metric is in speech recognition. Moore et al. (2026) benchmark five ASR architectures and six adaptation strategies under CER, SER and the three SWER variants, and report ranking differences between SER and CER, the same architectural ranking under all three word-level metrics, and a fall in the CER–SER correlation under parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 对藏语来说,唯一比较一个词级的度量衡是语音识别. 摩尔等. (2026年)基准CER,SER和SWER三个变体下的5个ASR架构和6个适应策略,并报告SER和CER的排名差异,所有3个词级度量下相同的建筑排名,以及参数效率微调下的CER–SER关联性下降.

blocks.en: 2.4.3. Downstream Use of Recognition Output
blocks.zh: 2.4.3. 下游识别产出的使用

blocks.en: Recognition output is often the input to a further process, and its quality has been measured by the degradation it causes there. van Strien et al. (2020) evaluate six tasks across OCR output of varying quality and report a consistent impact across all six. Hamdi et al. (2019) find named-entity F-score falling from roughly 90% to 60% once word-level error rates reach the 8–20% range. Jaud et al. (2025) report that corrupting named-entity spans sharply reduces keyword search performance while CER and WER remain low, whereas corrupting the same proportion of non-entity tokens raises both rates and leaves retrieval comparatively stable.
blocks.zh: 识别产出往往是对进一步进程的投入,其质量是通过它造成的退化来衡量的。 van Strien等人(2020年)评价了OCR不同质量产出的6项任务,并报告了所有6项任务的持续影响。 Hamdi等人(2019年)发现,当字面误差率达到8-20%的范围时,F-score的名字实体从大约90%下降到60%。 贾乌德等. (2025年)报告,腐败的命名实体跨度大幅降低关键字搜索性能,而CER和WER仍然很低,而腐败的同样比例的非实体符号既提高了率,也使得检索相对稳定.

blocks.en: Downstream resources for Tibetan are limited. Meelen and Hill (2017) tag Classical Tibetan under a purpose-built tagset. A 20,215-sentence Tibetan named-entity corpus is available on request rather than publicly released, and recent entity recognition work on it fine-tunes a large language model with domain prompts ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Tibetan machine translation has concentrated on the Tibetan–Chinese pair Moore and Lauren, 2025 ; e.g. Zhou et al., 2024 , with few studies of Tibetan–English ( Shu et al., 2024 ; Nehrdich and Keutzer, 2026 ; Moore and Lauren, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 下游藏族资源有限. Meelen and Hill (2017) 标注古典藏语,在目的建造的标签集下. 一份20,215份西藏语命名实体书是应请求提供的,而不是公开发布的,最近实体的确认工作对一个大语言模型进行了细化,有域提示(Zhang等人,2025年)。 藏机译本主要集中在藏文—中国的对摩尔和劳伦,2025年;例如. 周等人,2024年,藏语英语研究不多(Shu等人,2024年;Nehrdich and Keutzer,2026年;Moore and Lauren,2025年).

blocks.en: Griffiths (2024) notes that a CER under 10% is “considered efficient” for automatic transcription, and sets 5% as the project’s target for text mining, though neither threshold is explicitly validated.
blocks.zh: Griffiths(2024年)指出,10%以下的CER对于自动转录来说“被认为有效”,并将5%作为项目的目标,尽管这两个阈值都没有明确验证。

blocks.en: 3. Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Nine recognizer configurations are evaluated on seven data conditions, four single-domain and three mixed-domain (§ 3.1 –§ 3.3 ). Each of the resulting 60 cells is scored on a held-out test split under five error rates (§ 3.4 ). Error concentration is measured per cell (§ 3.5 ), and the rates are compared across systems, lines and training conditions (§ 3.6 ). On the four single-domain conditions, recognizer output is also passed to three downstream tasks (§ 3.7 ).
blocks.zh: 9个识别器配置在7个数据条件,4个单一域和3个混合域(§3.1 QQ 3.3)上得到评价. 所产生的60个单元格中每个单元格在5个误差率(第3.4节)下分解的搁置试验中得分。 每个单元格测得误差浓度(第3.5节),并比较系统、线路和培训条件(第3.6节)。 在四个单域条件下,识别器输出也传递给三个下游任务(§3.7.).

blocks.en: 3.1. Datasets and Splits
blocks.zh: 3.1. 数据集和划分

blocks.en: Four publicly available datasets from the Hugging Face Hub are used, spanning the principal script domains of historical and contemporary Tibetan OCR (§ 2.1.2 ): KhyentseWangpo ( BDRC/KhyentseWangpo , modern typeset), Karmapa8 ( BDRC/Karmapa8 , woodblock print), Drutsa ( openpecha/OCR-Drutsa , cursive dbu med handwriting) and Betsug ( openpecha/OCR-Betsug , semi-cursive dbu med handwriting). All four supply pre-cropped line images paired with transcriptions. Statistics are given in Table 1 and example lines in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 使用了四个公开的来自Hugging Face Hub的数据集,跨越了历史和当代西藏OCR的主要脚本领域(§2.1.2):KhyentseWangpo(BDRC/KhyentseWangpo,现代类型),Karmapa8(BDRC/Karmapa8,木块印),Drutsa(openpecha/OCR-Drutsa,cursive dbu med stripture)和Betsug(oppecha/OCR-Betsug,半曲线的dbu med stripting). 所有4个供应预铺设的线路图像都配对了抄录. 统计数字见表1和图1示例。

blocks.en: All datasets are split 90/10 by page, pages drawn randomly until the test set first reaches the target size. A mixed condition is the concatenation of its components’ splits, so each mixed test set is the union of the corresponding single-domain test sets.
blocks.zh: 所有数据集均按页面划分90/10,页面随机抽取,直到测试集首次达到目标大小. 一个混合条件就是其组件的分裂的调和,因此每个混合测试集都是相应的单域测试集的结合.

blocks.en: 3.2. Models
Five architectures are evaluated (Table 2 ), spanning the CTC, autoregressive encoder-decoder and vision-language classes of § 2.2.1 .
blocks.zh: 评估了五套建筑(表2),涵盖气候技术中心、自动编码器-解码器以及第2.2.1节的视觉语言类。

blocks.en: Table 2. Model architectures. TrOCR checkpoints are stage-1 pretrained on synthetic printed text-line images ( Li et al., 2023 ) . Table of the five model architectures, their type, and parameter counts.
blocks.zh: 图表 2. 示范建筑。 TrOCR检查站对合成印刷文本线图像进行第一级预训(Li等人,2023年)。 五个模型架构的表格,其类型,参数计算.

blocks.en: Both follow their published specifications with two exceptions. CRNN takes input 64 px high rather than 32 px, because Tibetan stacks up to four glyph components vertically. Easter2.0 is reimplemented without its TACo augmentation and weighted CTC loss, so that the two CTC models share one training procedure. Line images are resized to 64 × 2048 64\times 2048 px, and both models produce about 512 output frames per line, more than the number of characters in any reference line.
blocks.zh: 两者都遵循其公布的规格,但有两个例外. CRNN取输入64px高,而不是32px,因为藏语堆栈高达四个glyph元件垂直. 复活节2.0重新实施时没有TACo扩增和CTC加权损失,因此两个CTC模式共用一个培训程序. 线条图像的大小调整为64×2048 64\times 2048 px,两种模型每行输出框约512个,超过任何参考线中的字符数量.

blocks.en: The pretrained decoders are initialized from RoBERTa and MiniLM ( Li et al., 2023 ) , whose subword vocabularies were not built for Tibetan. The decoder vocabulary is replaced with a Tibetan character vocabulary before fine-tuning: embed_tokens and output_projection are resized and randomly reinitialized, while all encoder and decoder weights are retained. Images are resized to 384 × 384 384\times 384 by the checkpoint’s processor.
blocks.zh: 预训解码器由RoBERTa和MiniLM(Li et al., 2023)初始化,其子词组并非为藏语而建. 解码器词汇在微调前被藏文字符词汇取代: 嵌入_tokens和输出_projection被调整大小和随机重新初始化,同时保留所有编码器和解码器重量. 图片由检查站处理器调整为384×384=times 384。

blocks.en: Its byte-level BPE covers the Tibetan block (U+0F00–0FFF) at ∼ \sim 1.33 tokens per character. The model is prompted with a fixed instruction (Appendix A.1 ) and the line image. Qwen3-VL is trained only on the four single-domain datasets, with 4-bit QLoRA: adapters ( r = 8 r=8 , α = 16 \alpha=16 , dropout 0.1 0.1 ) on the attention and feed-forward projections.
blocks.zh: 其字节级的BPE覆盖藏语区块(U+0F00–0FFF),为每个字符的\sim 1.33令牌. 该模型以固定指令(Appendix A.1 )和线条图像来推动. Qwen3-VL只接受四个单域数据集的培训,其中4位QLORA:适配器(r = 8 r = 8,α = 16\alpha = 16,退出0.1 )在注意和饲料前导预测.

blocks.en: 3.3. Adaptation and Training
blocks.zh: 3.3. 适应和培训

blocks.en: Each TrOCR size is used in three configurations: standard fine-tuning, and 8-bit and 4-bit quantization (§ 2.2.2 ) of the fine-tuned checkpoint after training, which are not trained separately. CRNN and Easter2.0 receive standard fine-tuning only, and Qwen3-VL 4-bit QLoRA only.
blocks.zh: 每个TrOCR大小在三种配置中使用:标准微调,训练后微调检查站的8位和4位(§2.2.2),这些不单独训练. CRNN和复活节2.0只接受标准的微调,而Quen3-VL 4位QLORA只接受.

blocks.en: Table 3. Per-architecture hyperparameters. The 8-bit optimizer is that of Dettmers et al. (2022b) . Epochs is the number of passes over the training set implied by a 4,000-step single-domain run at the given effective batch size, as a range over the four single-domain datasets. Table of per-architecture training batch size, effective batch size, implied epoch count, learning rate, and optimizer.
blocks.zh: 图表 3. 人均建筑超参数。 8位优化器是Dettmers等人(2022b). Epochs是按给定的有效批量大小运行的4000步单域所暗示的通过训练集的次数,作为四个单域数据集的射程. 每批建筑训练批量大小表,有效批量大小表,隐含时代计数表,学习率表,优化表.

blocks.en: Shared across every run: 4,000 / 8,000 / 16,000 total steps for 1 / 2 / 4 datasets, scaled so that the number of epochs per example is approximately constant across conditions; a linear warmup over the first 12.5% of the budget followed by linear decay to zero; and seed 42. CRNN, Easter2.0, TrOCR-small standard and TrOCR-base standard are additionally retrained at seeds 43 and 44 on Karmapa8 and Drutsa, and Qwen3-VL at both seeds on Drutsa; their quantized variants inherit the seed of the checkpoint they quantize. Decoding is greedy, with TrOCR capped at 460 generated tokens and Qwen3-VL at 768.
blocks.zh: 每跑一次共用:4 000/8 000/16 000个总步数,用于1/2/4个数据集,按比例计算,每个实例的时代数目在各条件之间大致保持不变;预算头12.5%的线性暖化,然后线性衰变为零;种子42。 CRNN,复活节2.0,TrOCR-小标准和TrOCR-碱基标准在Karmapa8和Drutsa的种子43和44上额外重新训练,在Drutsa的种子2上进行Quen3-VL;其量化的变种继承了检查站的种子它们被量化. 解码很贪婪,TrOCR封顶460个生成的代币,Qune3-VL封顶768个.

blocks.en: CRNN, Easter2.0 and TrOCR share a character-level vocabulary built from the training split. Out-of-vocabulary test characters count as errors but no test split contains more than ten of them, at most 0.0013% of test characters. Qwen3-VL keeps its pretrained vocabulary unchanged.
blocks.zh: CRNN,复活节2.0和TrOCR共享从训练分裂中构建的字符级词汇. 省外测试字符计为误差,但没有测试分数包含超过10个,最多为测试字符的0.0013%. Qune3-VL保持其预训词汇不变.

blocks.en: Where results are aggregated above individual configurations, the nine configurations are grouped into four families: CTC (CRNN, Easter2.0), TrOCR-small and TrOCR-base (the standard, 8-bit and 4-bit variants of each), and Qwen3-VL . The two TrOCR sizes are kept apart, differing by a factor of ten in parameters.
blocks.zh: 在结果大于单个配置的情况下,将9个配置组合成4个家族:CTC(CRNN,复活节2.0),TrOCR-小和TrOCR-碱(每个组合的标准,8位和4位的变体),以及Qune3-VL. 两种TrOCR大小是分开的,在参数上因十而异.

blocks.en: All experiments ran on a single NVIDIA RTX 4050 Laptop GPU with 6 GB of VRAM, which restricts Qwen3-VL to QLoRA.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都运行在一个单 NVIDIA RTX 4050 笔记本电脑GPU上,并配有6GB的VRAM,它将Qune3-VL限制在QLORA.

blocks.en: 3.4. Metrics

All metrics are defined in § 2.3 and computed directly on hypothesis and reference strings, following the tibetan-wer package 1 1 1 https://pypi.org/project/tibetan-wer/ . Rates are macro-averaged, each line weighted equally, except for the paired per-component comparisons of transfer, which are micro-averaged.
blocks.zh: 所有度量衡都在第2.3节中定义,直接按照假说和参考字符串计算,按照提贝坦-wer包1 1 1 https://pypi.org/project/tibetan-wer/. 比率是宏观平均的,每行均匀加权,但转让的每个组件对等比较除外,后者是微观平均的。

blocks.en: Leading and trailing whitespace is stripped from every reference and hypothesis before scoring. CER is computed over the codepoints of the stored strings, with no Unicode normalization or punctuation stripping. A syllable for SER is a maximal run of characters between delimiters: whitespace, the tsheg and tsheg bstar (U+0F0B–0F0C), the shad and the other head, clause and section marks (U+0F04–0F14 and U+0F34, U+0F3A–0F3D, U+0FD0–0FD4, U+0FD9–0FDA). The delimiters are not scored.
blocks.zh: 领先和落后的白空间在评分前被从每一个参考和假设中剥离. CER是通过存储字符串的代码点计算出来的,没有Unicode正常化或标点剥离. SER的一个音节是分隔符之间字符的最大运行:白空间,tsheg和tsheg bstar(U+0F0B–0F0C),shad和另一个头,条和段标记(U+0F04–0F14和U+0F34,U+0F3A–0F3D,U+0FD0–0FD4,U+0FD9–0FDA). 分隔符未得分.

blocks.en: The three SWER variants use the segmenters of § 2.3 . On the reference lines of the downstream subset, BoTok and BERT words average 1.3 syllables and Gemini words 2.9. Because of API cost, Gem-SWER is computed on a seeded random sample of 500 lines per condition, with the prompt of Appendix A.2 . On the mixed conditions the 500 lines are allocated across the components in proportion to their test-split sizes, and each component’s lines are drawn from that component’s single-domain sample. Before segmentation, strings whose character-type repetition ratio — length divided by number of distinct characters — exceeds 10 are excluded, because API calls time out. A line is dropped if either its reference or hypothesis trips the filter.
blocks.zh: 三种SWER变体使用第2.3节的分段器. 在下游子集的参考线上,BoTok和BERT单词平均1.3音节和双子座单词2.9. 由于API成本,Gem-SWER是按每个条件500行的种子随机抽样计算,并带有附录A.2。 在混合条件下,500条线路按其试验区块大小的比例在各部分之间分配,每个部分的线路都取自该部分的单域样本。 在分割前,其字符类型重复比率——长度除以显著字符数——超过10的字符串被排除在外,因为API呼叫超时. 如果一个线条的引用或假说经过过滤器,则该线条将被删除。

blocks.en: 3.5. Error Concentration
blocks.zh: 3.5. 误差浓度

blocks.en: Error concentration is the share of error-free lines and the share of summed error contributed by the worst decile of lines, computed per cell over the per-line CER array and over the per-line SER array. It requires no segmenter.
blocks.zh: 错误浓度是无错误线和由最差的十分位线造成的总和错误的比例,每个单元格在每行CER阵列和每行SER阵列上计算。 不需要分层器。

blocks.en: 3.6. Statistical Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.6. 统计分析

blocks.en: Two systems compared on the same lines are tested with a paired bootstrap over test pages: pages are resampled 10,000 times, the difference is recomputed on the lines of the sampled pages, and it is significant when its 95% interval excludes zero. No multiple-comparison correction is applied.
blocks.zh: 在同一行上比较的两个系统在测试页上用对齐的靴子进行测试:页面被重印1万次,在样本页的行上重算差异,当其95%的间隔排除0时则显著. 不实行多比校正.

blocks.en: Transfer between the mixed and single-domain conditions is measured per component: the mixed-trained and single-domain-trained models are scored on the identical lines the split makes common to both (§ 1 ) and the difference assessed by the paired bootstrap above.
blocks.zh: 混合和单一域条件之间的转移按组件进行测量:混合训练的和单一域训练的模型的得分相同,分为两个部分(第1节)共同的线条和上面对配对的靴子所评估的差别。

blocks.en: A ranking reversal is a pair of configurations that CER and every metric above the character level order in opposite directions. Gem-SWER is excluded from the search and from the paired transfer comparisons, being measured on a different sample (§ 3.4 ); where it differs from the other three, this is reported. The search is exhaustive over every pair of configurations in every condition, so a pair may differ in quantization, in size or in architecture. A reversal is significant when the paired difference is significant on CER and, in the opposite direction, on at least two of SER, BoTok-SWER and BERT-SWER.
blocks.zh: 排名反转是一对组合,CER和字符级别上方的每个公尺顺序都是相反方向的. 宝石... SWER被排除在搜索和配对转移比较之外,在不同的样本中进行测量(第3.4节);如果与其他三个样本不同,则报告这种情况。 搜索在每一个条件的每对配置中都是详尽无遗的,因此一对在量化,大小或建筑上可能有所不同. 当配对差异在CER上显著,而在相反的方向上,在至少两个SER,BoTok-SWER和BERT-SWER上,反转是显著的.

blocks.en: Correlations are quantified at two levels. Between per-line metric arrays we report Spearman ρ \rho , computed within each model–condition cell separately. At the ranking level, models are ordered by each metric within each condition and the orderings compared with Kendall’s τ \tau . The same procedure across the three SWER variants measures whether the segmenter changes the ordering.
blocks.zh: 关联性分两个层次量化. 在每行度量阵列之间,我们报告 Spearman ^\rho, 在每个模式-条件单元格中分别计算 。 与肯德尔的\tau相比, 三个SWER变体的相同程序衡量分机是否改变订单.

blocks.en: 3.7. Downstream Task Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.7. 下游任务评价

blocks.en: No gold English translation and no gold Tibetan entity annotation exist for these test sets, so absolute downstream quality cannot be measured. Following van Strien et al. (2020) , a downstream system’s output on clean text is taken as the ground truth for its output on OCR’d text. Downstream figures are therefore preservation scores, measuring the effect of recognition error on the task, not the system’s accuracy.
blocks.zh: 这些测试集没有金英译本和金藏实体注释,因此绝对下游质量无法测量. 在Van Strien等人(2020年)之后,下游系统关于干净文本的输出被视为其OCRd文本输出的底线真相. 因此,下游数字是保存分数,衡量识别错误对任务的影响,而不是系统的准确性。

blocks.en: Evaluation uses the 500-line sample of each single-domain condition, the same lines as Gem-SWER, and all nine configurations (Table 4 ). Part-of-speech and entity preservation are F 1 over per-line items, repeated items counted separately, averaged over lines; translation preservation is corpus chrF ( Popović, 2015 ) ( β = 2 \beta=2 , character 6-grams) and BLEU, both via sacreBLEU 2.6.0 ( Post, 2018 ) with default settings, and sentence chrF and BLEURT ( Sellam et al., 2020 ) , a learned metric rather than surface overlap, from the original BLEURT checkpoint, whose scores fall below zero for inadequate translations, each averaged over lines. Where the annotator returns no usable output for a hypothesis, the hypothesis is scored as empty output rather than dropped, so the failure counts against the system that produced the line. A line whose reference the annotator could not process has no gold target and drops out. Downstream targets are set at round values of each measure (0.8 and 0.9 for part-of-speech F 1 , 0.6 and 0.8 for entity F 1 , 60 for chrF, 0.60 for BLEURT), chosen as reasonable levels of preservation for rough guidance; an error rate separates a target when every cell meeting it has a lower rate than every cell missing it.
blocks.zh: 评价使用每个单域条件的500行样本,与Gem-SWER相同的线路,以及所有9个配置(表4 ). 部分语音和实体保存是F 1 凌驾于每行物品之上,重复的项目分开计算,平均是行;翻译保存是eural chrF(Popović,2015年)(β = 2\β=2,字符 6-g)和BLEU,两者均通过默认设置的sacrebleU 2.6.0(Post,2018年),句子chrF和BLEURT(Sellam et al.,2020年),这是从原BLEURT检查站获得的学习度数而不是表面重叠,其分数因翻译不当而低于零,均是线上的平均值. 当注释者返回一个假说没有可用的输出时,该假说被打成空输出而不是丢弃,所以失败算作产生该线的系统. 注释者无法处理的线条没有金色目标并退出。 下游目标被设定为每项计量的圆值(0.8和0.9分F部分,0.6和0.8分F实体1,60分ChrF,0.60分BLEURT),作为粗略导理的合理保存水平;一个误差率将一个目标分离出来,当每个单元格相遇时,其误差率低于每个单元格。

blocks.en: Table 4. Downstream tasks. All are scored as preservation against reference-derived output. Entity labels are PER, LOC, ORG and WORK, the last for text titles. Table of the three downstream tasks, the annotator used for each, and the measures reported.

blocks.en: Tagging uses tibetan-bert-base-upos , the model that also supplies the BERT-SWER segmentation, run locally: the word boundaries it induces are kept together with their UPOS labels, so each string becomes a sequence of (word, tag) pairs. The reference and every hypothesis are tagged this way, truncated to 800 characters and subject to the repetition filter of § 3.4 .
blocks.zh: Tagging使用tibetan-bert-base-upos,这个模式也供应了BERT-SWER的分区,在当地运行:它诱导的词边界与它们的UPOS标签一起保存,因此每个字符串成为一对(词,标记)的序列. 引用和每个假说都用这种方式标注,切换到800个字符,并经过3.4节的重复过滤。

blocks.en: Entities and translation are annotated by Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite (§ 2.4.3 ). Requests are batched four lines at a time under the repetition filter of § 3.4 , each line truncated to 500 characters; prompts are in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 实体和翻译由双子座2.5 Flash Lite(§ 2.4.3)注释. 请求在3.4节的重复过滤器下一次分批四行进行,每行切换为500个字符;提示在附录A.3中.

blocks.en: For every string, whether usable output was returned is recorded, with reference lines as the control, separating strings excluded by the repetition filter from strings queried without parseable output. A failing request is retried, finally without the translation field (Appendix A.4 ).
blocks.zh: 对于每一个字符串,是否返回可用的输出都会被记录下来,以引用行为控件,将被重复过滤器排除的字符串与被询问的没有解析输出的字符串分开. 一个失败的请求被重新审理,最终没有翻译字段(Appendix A.4 .

A line the annotator cannot process is scored as empty output (§ 3.7 ), so every measure covers at least 493 of the 500 lines per cell; the lines that drop out are those whose reference it could not process. The annotator returns no usable output, an empty or unparseable response, for up to 1.4% of a cell’s lines, at a rate that correlates with CER at ρ = + 0.622 \rho=+0.622 .

blocks.en: 5. Discussion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1. Ranking Agreement
blocks.zh: 5.1. 排序协定

blocks.en: In general, rankings of systems agree across the metric levels. Kendall τ \tau between the CER ranking and each syllable- or word-level ranking never falls below 0.833 (§ 4.2.1 ). This is consistent with Vesalainen et al. (2026) , but contrasts with the ranking reversals seen elsewhere ( Agbeti-Messan et al., 2026 ; Le et al., 2025 ; Moore et al., 2026 ) . We find only one reversal, which holds across training seeds. On it, downstream translation favours the ordering given by the segmented word error rates (§ 4.2.3 ).
blocks.zh: 一般而言,系统的排名在衡量级别上是一致的。 CER排名与每个音节或词级排名之间的肯德尔\tau从未低于0.833(§4.2.1). 这与Vesalainen等人(2026年)是一致的,但与其他地方的排名逆转形成对比(Agbeti-Messan等人,2026年;Le等人,2025年;Moore等人,2026年)。 我们只发现一个逆转,它贯穿着训练种子。 关于这一点,下游译文倾向于分字错误率给出的订单(第4.2.3节)。

blocks.en: Rankings computed over the three segmenters agree at a median pairwise τ \tau of 1.000 (§ 4.2.1 ). Which segmenter is used does not change which system a word-level rate judges better, as Moore et al. (2026) found for automatic speech recognition.
blocks.zh: 3个段的排名按1 000的中位对数=\tau计算(第4.2.1节)。 像Moore等人一样,使用哪一个分机并不改变哪个系统一个字位率评委更好. (2026)发现自动语音识别.

blocks.en: Line by line, CER and SER diverge for two reasons. Across cells, per-line CER ∼ \sim SER agreement falls with mean CER at ρ = − 0.447 \rho=-0.447 (§ 4.2.2 ). At a given error rate, it also depends on how much of a system’s character error falls on whitespace, which CER counts and SER does not: the CTC models, with a median of 30.9% of character edits on whitespace, agree at 0.598–0.746 on the conditions containing handwriting, where TrOCR-base cells at comparable CER agree at 0.940–0.975. A CER-only evaluation of such a system therefore ranks its lines partly by whitespace errors, which SER does not score. Agreement among SER, BoTok-SWER and BERT-SWER is positive in every cell. Moore et al. (2026) report the CER–SER correlation falling under parameter-efficient fine-tuning; here it falls with the error rate within the CTC and TrOCR-small families.
blocks.zh: CER和SER因两个原因各行不同。 纵观各单元格,每行CER \\ sim SER协议与平均CER的比值为 ^ = − 0.447\rho=-0.447 (§ 4.2.2 )。 在给定的误差速率下,它也取决于一个系统的字符误差有多少落在白空间上,而CER计算而SER不计算:CTC模型在白空间上字符编辑的中位数为30.9%,在包含笔迹的条件上在0.598–0.746上达成一致,其中TrOCR基单元格在相当的CER上同意在0.940–0.975上. 因此,对这种系统的只使用CER的评价部分地以白空差错排行,SER没有得分. 每个细胞中SER、BoTok-SWER和BERT-SWER之间的协议都是积极的。 摩尔等. (2026)报告CER-SER的关联性属于参数效率微调;这里它与CTC和TrOCR小家族内部的误差率有关.

blocks.en: 5.2. Disagreement Between the Rates
blocks.zh: 5.2. 费率之间的分歧

blocks.en: On a decision about a single system, CER can give the opposite answer from the rates above it. Comparing joint with single-domain training on identical lines, CER and a syllable- or word-level rate record significant changes of opposite sign in ten of the 64 cells, eight of them TrOCR-small 4-bit cells, where CER records an improvement (§ 4.2.3 ).
blocks.zh: 在就单一系统作出决定时,核证的排减量可以提供与其以上比率相反的答案。 与相同线的单域训练相比较,CER和音节或词级速率记录了64个单元格中10个单元格的相反符号的显著变化,其中8个为TrOCR-小4位单元格,其中CER记录有改进(§4.2.3)。

blocks.en: Conveniently, SER requires no segmenter, but ranks systems as BoTok-SWER and BERT-SWER do at Kendall τ ≥ 0.889 \tau\geq 0.889 (§ 4.2.1 , § 3.4 ); the words of those two segmenters average 1.3 syllables. The same reasoning led Naing et al. (2015) to a syllable error rate for Myanmar speech recognition, where the definition of a word is ambiguous.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,SER不需要分机,而是按照Botok-SWER和BERT-SWER在Kendall & 0.889\tau\geq 0.889 (§ 4.2.1,§3.4)中所做的系统排序;这两个分机的词平均为1.3音节. 同样的推理导致Naing等人(2015年)对缅甸语音识别产生音节错误率,其中一个词的定义模糊不清.

blocks.en: 5.3. Error Rate and Downstream Use
blocks.zh: 5.3. 误差率和下游使用

blocks.en: As rough guidance, with arbitrary but reasonable targets, part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 is reached only at SER 0.078 or below and translation chrF of 60 at 0.047 or below; the corresponding CER bands are 0.047–0.078 and 0.025–0.028 (§ 4.4 ). No rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that miss it. The 5% CER that Griffiths (2024) sets for text mining falls within the tagging band; the 10% described there as efficient for automatic transcription lies above it.
blocks.zh: 作为粗略的指导,如果有任意但合理的目标,则只达到0.8的语音部分保留,即SER 0.078或以下,翻译为60的chrF,即0.047或以下;相应的CER波段为0.047-0.078和0.025-0.028(§4.4)。 没有将达到实体保全0.6的系统与错过的系统区分开来。 Griffiths(2024年)为文本挖掘设定的5%CER属于标记带;其中10%被描述为高效的自动抄录位于上面.

blocks.en: Across the three tasks, the SER needed ranges from 0.007 for entity preservation of 0.8 to 0.078 for part-of-speech preservation of 0.8, so no single acceptable rate serves every downstream use of Tibetan OCR at either the character or the syllable level. Entity preservation degrades fastest of the three tasks and is the hardest to predict, at ρ = − 0.854 \rho=-0.854 for CER and − 0.887 -0.887 for SER (Table 9 ). Hamdi et al. (2019) also report entity extraction degrading sharply under OCR error, and Jaud et al. (2025) , using simulated OCR noise, find the loss concentrated in errors that fall on entity spans.
blocks.zh: 在三项任务中,所需SER从0.007不等,实体保全0.8至0.078不等,部分声波保全0.8,因此,在字符或音节级别上,西藏OCR的下游使用均无单一可接受率。 在三项任务中,实体保全降解速度最快,最难预测的是:CER=−0.854\rho=-0.854,SER为−0.887-0.887(表9)。 Hamdi等人(2019年)也报告实体在OCR误差下急剧降解,Jaud等人(2025年)利用模拟OCR噪声发现损失集中在实体跨度的错误上.

blocks.en: Entity extraction and translation are performed by an LLM, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, which fails to return usable output more often as its input degrades (§ 4.4.3 ). Unreliable behaviour of language and translation models on noisy OCR text, on perturbed source input and in low-resource translation has been reported before ( Piryani et al., 2025 ; Raunak et al., 2021 ; Guerreiro et al., 2023 ) . Failures are scored as empty output, so they count against the score. An evaluation that places an LLM annotator downstream of OCR ought thus to report the annotator’s coverage and how its failures are scored.
blocks.zh: 实体提取和翻译由一个LLM(双子座2.5 Flash Lite)进行,由于输入的降解,它无法更经常地返回可用的输出(§4.4.3). 以前曾报告过在吵闹的OCR文本、扰动源输入和低资源翻译上语言和翻译模型的不可靠行为(Piryani等人,2025年;Raunak等人,2021年;Guerreiro等人,2023年)。 失败者得分为空输出,因此与得分比计数. 因此,在OCR下游设置LLM标注员的评估应该报告标注员的覆盖范围及其失败的得分。

blocks.en: 6. Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: 6.1. Limitations

Splits are grouped by page, not by text or scribe. Other pages of a test page’s text, and other lines in its scribe’s hand, can occur in training, so the error rates reported may be lower than those on unseen texts or hands, particularly on handwriting.
blocks.zh: 拆分按页面分组,不按文字或文员分组. 测试页文本的其他几页,以及书记官手中的其他行,都可以在训练中出现,因此所报告的误差率可能低于未见文本或手上的误差率,特别是在笔迹上。

blocks.en: Training settings differ by architecture: batch size, learning rate and the number of passes over the training data were each set by hardware constraints and training stability (Table 3 ). Differences between architecture families therefore include differences in optimization.
blocks.zh: 培训环境因结构不同而不同:批量规模、学习率和通过培训数据的次数均由硬件限制和培训稳定性决定(表3)。 因此,建筑家族之间的差异包括优化差异.

blocks.en: Part-of-speech tagging and BERT-SWER use the same model, so the two are not independent. Gem-SWER, entity extraction and translation use a hosted model that cannot be pinned to a version.
blocks.zh: 部分语句标记和BERT-SWER使用相同的模型,因此两者不独立. Gem-SWER,实体提取和翻译使用一个主机模型,不能固定在一个版本上.

blocks.en: The downstream figures are preservation against a fixed annotator’s output on the reference rather than accuracy, as no gold Tibetan entity annotation or English translation exists for these test sets (§ 3.7 ). They cover the nine configurations on a 500-line random sample of each single-domain test split (§ 3.4 ). Gem-SWER is computed on the same lines. The reliability of LLMs as evaluators varies across models and tasks ( Bavaresco et al., 2025 ) , particularly in low-resource and multilingual settings ( Fu and Liu, 2025 ; Doğruöz et al., 2026 ) , and the same may hold for LLM annotators. A single annotator is used, so its errors are not separated from those caused by recognition. About 4% of entity spans, on references and hypotheses alike, are returned as English renderings that cannot match a Tibetan span, so the entity bands in particular are relative quantities. The downstream targets are round values chosen for rough guidance.
blocks.zh: 下游的数字是对照一个固定的注释员的参考产出而不是准确性的,因为这些测试集没有金藏实体的注释或英文译本(第3.7节)。 它们覆盖每个单一域测试分拆的500行随机样本上的9个配置(§3.4). Gem-SWER是按同一线计算的。 有限责任公司作为评价者的可靠性因模型和任务而异(Bavaresco等人,2025年),特别是在资源匮乏和多种语言环境中(Fu和Liu,2025年;Doğruöz等人,2026年),LLM注释者可能也持有这种可靠性。 使用单一的注释器,因此其错误不会与识别引起的错误分开. 大约4%的实体跨度,在参考文献和假说上都一样,作为无法匹配藏文跨度的英文渲染器返回,因此实体波段尤其相对数量. 下游的目标是为粗略指导选择的圆值。

blocks.en: 6.2. Future Work
blocks.zh: 6.2. 今后的工作

blocks.en: Future work should extend this analysis to other scripts that leave word boundaries unmarked, such as other Tibetic languages (e.g. Dzongkha) or the Brahmic abugidas of mainland Southeast Asia (Thai, Lao, Khmer and Burmese).
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应当将这一分析扩展到其他未标明字段界限的文字,例如其他西藏语言(如宗卡语)或东南亚大陆的婆罗门语(泰语、老挝语、高棉语和缅甸语).

blocks.en: Evaluation should also be extended to the full pipeline, with layout detection and line segmentation before recognition, where the page-level measures of Bourne et al. (2026) apply; this study assumes correct line segmentation (§ 2.3 ). Scoring one recognizer on gold and on predicted line crops would separate segmentation error from recognition error, particularly on handwriting.
blocks.zh: 评价还应扩展到整个管道,在识别前进行布局检测和线段划分,其中适用Bourne等人(2026年)的页面测量;本研究假设正确的线段划分(第2.3节)。 在黄金和预测的线粒体作物上对一个识别器进行分解,将区分分解错误和识别错误,特别是笔迹。

blocks.en: Post-editing effort should be measured directly and related to per-line error concentration. Correction time has been measured for OCR ( Rijhwani et al., 2023 ) and transcription time with ASR output visible for speech ( Sperber et al., 2017 ) , and for machine translation edit distance to the post-edited output has been compared with perceived effort ( Koponen, 2012 ) .
blocks.zh: 编辑后的工作应当直接计量,并与每行误差浓度有关. 对OCR(Rijhwani等人,2023年)的校正时间和ASR输出可见的校正时间进行了测量(Sperber等人,2017年),对机器翻译编辑到编辑后输出的距离进行了与感知努力的比较(Koponen,2012年)。

blocks.en: 7. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en: This study reports syllable- and word-level error rates for Tibetan OCR, to our knowledge for the first time. Nine configurations from three architecture classes, CTC recognizers, TrOCR encoder–decoders with and without post-training quantization and a vision-language model adapted with QLoRA, were evaluated on seven conditions drawn from typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles. Each was scored under CER, SER and three segmented word error rates on page-grouped held-out splits with bootstrap intervals. The rates were compared to one another, to the distribution of error over lines, and to the preservation of part-of-speech tags, named entities and translations computed from the output.
blocks.zh: 本研究报告西藏OCR的音节和词级误差率,这是我们第一次知道的. 来自三个建筑类的9个配置,CTC识别器,TrOCR编码器–解码器,有和没有训练后量化以及一个与QLORA相适应的视觉语言模型,根据从排版,木块和两个手写脚本风格抽取的7个条件进行了评价. 每一分数在CER、SER和三个分块字误差率下分出,分出页组,间隔为靴子。 费率是相互比较的,是差错在行中的分布,是保留部分语音标记、命名实体和根据产出计算的翻译。

blocks.en: Tibetan OCR evaluations should report SER alongside CER. SER requires no segmenter, lexicon or model. CER broadly agrees with the higher-level rates on rankings, with one reversal, on which translation quality favours the ordering given by the segmented rates (§ 5.1 ). On decisions about a single system, such as whether joint training helped, CER and SER can disagree in sign (§ 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 西藏OCR评价应与CER一起报告SER. SER不需要分册,词典或模型. CER大致同意排名较高的比率,但有一个倒置,翻译质量偏向于分层费率的顺序(第5.1节)。 关于单一制度的决定,例如联合培训是否有所帮助,CER和SER可在签名时出现分歧(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: Where an LLM is used to annotate OCR output for downstream evaluation, we recommend that its coverage be reported and its failures scored rather than dropped. Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite returned no usable output for up to 1.4% of lines, more often as its input degraded (§ 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 在使用LLM对OCR产出进行下游评价进行注释时,我们建议报告其覆盖范围,其失败得分而不是下降。 双子座 2.5 Flash Lite 返回了最多1.4%的线的可用输出,更常见的是,其输入退化(第5.3节).

blocks.en: As rough guidance for downstream use, the SER needed ranges from 0.078 or below for part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 to 0.007 or below for entity preservation of 0.8, so no single acceptable rate serves every downstream use. No rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that do not (§ 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 作为下游使用粗略的指南,在0.8至0.007或以下的语音部分保存方面,需要的SER为0.078或以下,实体保存为0.8,因此没有单一的可接受率为每下游使用服务。 没有费率将达到实体保全0.6的系统与非实体保全的系统区分开来(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: Data Availability
blocks.zh: 数据可用性

blocks.en: The four datasets are public Hugging Face repositories (Table 1 ). TrOCR is fine-tuned from the public checkpoints microsoft/trocr-small-stage1 and microsoft/trocr-base-stage1 , and Qwen3-VL from Qwen/ Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct ; CRNN and Easter2.0 are trained from random initialization. BERT-SWER segmentation and part-of-speech tagging use the public KoichiYasuoka/tibetan-bert-base-upos . CER, SER and the three SWER variants are computed with the public tibetan-wer package ( https://pypi.org/project/tibetan-wer/ ). All prompts are given in Appendix A . Training and evaluation code, trained checkpoints and recognizer outputs are available from the authors on reasonable request.
blocks.zh: 四个数据集是公共的Hugging Face寄存器(表1). TrOCR从公共检查站微软/trocr-小舞台1和微软/trocr-base-舞台1进行微调,Quen/Quen3-VL-2B-Instruct的Quen3-VL;CRNN和复活节2.0通过随机初始化训练. BERT-SWER的分化和部分语音标记使用公共的Koichi Yasuoka/tibetan-bert-base-upos. CER、SER和SWER三种变体用公共的tibetan-wer软件包(https://pypi.org/project/tibetan-wer/)计算。 所有提示载于附录A。 培训和评价守则、训练有素的检查站和识别器产出可应提交人的合理要求提供。
